text:
alex: Quick sync — I'm coordinating the docs PRs we need for the v3.5 rollout and the feature-flag cutover. Targeting public rollout Tue Apr 5. Need to lock a docs cutoff and agreed preview gating. Which PRs must wait for the FF to land, and which can go ahead?

Tara: Recommend a docs cutoff: EOD Thu Apr 1 UTC (after that only critical fixes). I'll own reviewer assignment and the merge order. Current priority list: PR #1342 (migration guide), #1351 (SDK snippet), #1360 (redirects rule).

Devlin: Heads-up — CI preview failed for #1342 with a broken link: /docs/migration/old-sdk -> 404. I pushed a quick path fix in the branch, but staging still shows the 404 on the preview.

ci-bot: Preview build failed for PR #1342 — build 3378. Logs: https://staging.builds/3378 (error: 1 broken link).

alex: @Tara please prioritize #1342 and #1351; we need both before GA. Hold other non-critical doc merges until preview is green. If preview flakes we can do ordered merges (migration guide first).

Miriam: For #1351 (SDK snippet) I'll include both JS + Python minimal examples and call out the breaking change in SDK 2.1. Snippet draft:
```js
// JS example for v3.5
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'Summarize the changes' });
console.log(resp.text);
```
```py
# Python example for v3.5
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-alpha', prompt='Summarize the changes')
print(resp.text)
```
I'll add a short note: "SDK 2.1 renames `client.call` -> `client.generate` and returns `resp.text` for streaming parity."

jen: Redirects: we need an infra redirect rule for /docs/migration/old-sdk -> /docs/v3.5/migration. I can land the redirect if infra approves; ETA EOD Fri Apr 3. Also flagging that S3/CloudFront TTL may cause preview flakiness.

Tara: Agree on freeze policy. Also: only allow `skip-preview` label for pure editorial whitespace/typo fixes and maintainers must sign off. No skipping for migration or SDK snippet changes.

docs-bot: Queued preview builds for PR #1342 and #1351 (build ids 3380, 3381). Check status with `/docs-preview status 1342` or visit https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/pr/1342.

Devlin: After the path fix I can reproduce link locally (passes), but staging still returns 404. Looks like cache/redirects not in sync. Quick remediation: re-run preview after the redirect rule is live, or we can merge the redirect first and then re-trigger the preview.

alex: Plan: 1) Hold non-critical docs after Apr 1 23:59 UTC. 2) Tara assigns reviewers + merge order: #1342 (migration) -> #1360 (redirects) -> #1351 (SDK snippet) so previews come up clean. 3) If preview remains flaky, we merge redirect first (infra-approved) and re-run preview. 4) No `skip-preview` except editorial.

Tara: I'll assign reviewers now: @Miriam on #1351, @Devlin on #1342, @jen to coordinate infra for #1360. I'll post a conf message in the release channel when merges start.

ci-bot: Build 3380 (PR #1342) still failing — re-run queued.

Miriam: I'll add the language snippets + callout and push an update to #1351 in the next 30m. Please add any sample prompts you want included.

jen: Filing infra ticket for redirect TTL and will ask for expedited review. Ticket: https://infra/RED-4321. ETA to land redirect Tue Apr 2 EOD.

Devlin: If anyone needs to re-run preview without waiting, use: `docs-bot rebuild 1342` — that forces a fresh build (note: costs CI minutes).

alex: Thanks all. TL;DR: freeze at Apr 1 EOD UTC, priority migration+redirect+snippet, no skip-preview except editorial, Tara to own reviewer assignment and merge order. :thumbsup:

Tara: :thumbsup: I'll update the docs checklist and publish a short release note for the docs team.
